FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the Middle Ages.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly. We must break free from the shackles of tradition. We must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in the latest fashions from the future. They are all wearing pastel-colored robes with neon accents, and their hair is styled in elaborate, futuristic updos.

KING
(to his courtiers)
I want our empire to be a beacon of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of retro-futurism. I want our architecture to be a blend of medieval grandeur and... of... (he snaps his fingers)...of VHS tape distortion.

COURTIER 1 (she)
But, Your Majesty, won't that be... confusing?

KING
(waving his hand dismissively)
Confusing? Ha! We will be the most... the most... (he grins)...the most avant-garde empire in all the land.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The king's vision is taking shape. The castle walls are now adorned with neon-lit tapestries, and the moat is filled with... with... (he searches for the right words)...with VHS tapes.

KING
(to his courtiers)
And I want our currency to be... to be... (he holds up a coin)...a fusion of medieval coins and... of... (he winks)...of cassette tapes.

COURTIER 2 (he)
But, Your Majesty, won't that be... impractical?

KING
(laughing)
Impractical? Ha! We will be the most... the most... (he grins)...the most innovative empire in all the land.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is now surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in their finest vaporwave attire. They are all sipping on... on... (he searches for the right words)...on futuristic cocktails, and they are all... (he gestures grandly)...they are all celebrating the dawn of a new era.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We will be the... the... (he smiles)...the most legendary empire in all the land. We will be the... the... (he winks)...the most vaporwave empire in all the land.

FADE TO BLACK.
